mandalorian_hijacker._comment: Mandalorian Hijacker. Mirrors Trask's flags so a galaxy-row capital ship becomes a legal target and is added to hand on destruction; hijackerExileCardId tells BOUNTY_HUNT to exile this unit when that happens.

A: └── Mandalorian Hijacker's ability: You can attack a capital ship in the galaxy row this turn. If you destroy it, Mandalorian Hijacker is exiled and you purchase that ship for free, adding it to your hand.
